rdRecord.question: Can the pinned Docker image be made available reliably on GitHub-hosted runners?
rdRecord.method: Web-only read-only retrieval from GitHub runner docs, actions/runner-images, Docker Hub tag API, Docker docs, retrieved 2026-09-02.
rdRecord.isolation: No repository writes or external mutations; researcher returned text only.
rdRecord.observation: Standard Ubuntu VM runners provide Docker; ubuntu-slim does not support Docker-in-Docker; node:22.22.0-bookworm-slim exists on Docker Hub as of retrieval, but pulls depend on registry/network and fresh runners do not retain images.
rdRecord.implication: Use standard ubuntu-24.04, pull/inspect before tests, record RepoDigest, and fail clearly on pull/architecture/network errors.

rdRecord.question: What path setup satisfies csm-browse's filesystem security contract in CI?
rdRecord.method: Hybrid read-only retrieval from repository security/constants plus GitHub variables, XDG, Linux path-resolution documentation, retrieved 2026-09-02.
rdRecord.isolation: No repository writes or external mutations; researcher returned text only.
rdRecord.observation: csm-browse rejects unsafe/symlink ancestors, derives config from HOME and sessions from XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/HOME, and accepts CSM_BROWSE_SESSIONS_ROOT before import. HOME alone is not proof of safe ancestry.
rdRecord.implication: Create and validate private roots component-by-component, set explicit HOME/XDG/session variables, then import/run csm-browse.

rdRecord.question: How should required and default CI gates be separated without false green status?
rdRecord.method: Hybrid read-only repository inspection and current GitHub Actions documentation, retrieved 2026-09-02.
rdRecord.isolation: No repository writes or external mutations; researcher returned text only.
rdRecord.observation: Default Make test keeps adapter gates separate, but the current workflow embeds them after default tests. Conditional skipped jobs can appear successful; required checks need an always-visible stable job that asserts prerequisites and fails explicitly.
rdRecord.implication: Create a dedicated unconditional job with stable name, timeout, explicit variable assertions, required-mode tests, and artifacts; update wiring tests.

rdRecord.question: What must the implementation prove beyond a successful docker pull?
rdRecord.method: Independent critique of the proposed design plus Docker/GitHub documentation, retrieved 2026-09-02.
rdRecord.isolation: No repository writes or external mutations; critic returned text only.
rdRecord.observation: Pulling an image does not prove its immutable identity, Docker execution, mounts, browser capability, cleanup, or exact workflow SHA; diagnostic artifact upload must not mask the original result.
rdRecord.implication: Add preflight inspect/RepoDigest checks, disposable container/config mount probes, bounded cleanup, redacted diagnostics, and event-specific SHA assertions.

design.job: Keep the existing default gates job for fast tests. Add an unconditional `adapter-integrations` job with `needs: gates`, `runs-on: ubuntu-24.04`, stable name, timeout, and an explicit prerequisite assertion step. Do not use a job-level conditional that can silently skip the required check.
design.paths: In the adapter job, create a private root using runner-supported variables, validate all ancestors with lstat/realpath and mode/ownership checks, set HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, and CSM_BROWSE_SESSIONS_ROOT before Node imports csm-browse.
design.images: Pull and inspect the exact sandbox image and the configured browser image; assert expected RepoDigests recorded by the plan/preflight. Run disposable Docker info/container/mount probes before live tests.
design.tests: Default `make test` skips only live capability tests. Required adapter mode runs live orchestration/browser tests, required browser E2E, and generated sandbox tests with no skip acceptance. Add wiring and negative tests.
design.diagnostics: Use bounded, redacted diagnostics under RUNNER_TEMP/workspace, collect TAP output, docker info/inspect/logs, image digests, path checks, and cleanup state in an always step; upload with pinned action SHA without overriding the test exit code.
design.sha: For push, compare git rev-parse HEAD to GITHUB_SHA; for pull_request, define and assert the intended event SHA explicitly. Publish SHA and image digests in the job summary/artifact metadata.
